comment: මගේ සැලෝන් එකට හිතපු විදිහටම ලස්සන website එකක් හදලා දුන්නා. Phone එකෙන් බලද්දිත් හරිම පිළිවෙළයි. වැඩේ ගැන ගොඩක් සතුටුයි.
translation: He built a beautiful website for my salon exactly as I imagined. It looks neat on mobile too. I'm very happy with the work.

comment: අපේ coffee shop එකට ගැළපෙන design එකක් හදලා දුන්නා. Menu එක වෙනස් කරගන්නත් ලේසියි. අපිට ඕන වෙනස්කම් ටිකත් හොඳට කරලා දුන්නා.
translation: He created a design that suits our coffee shop. Updating the menu is easy, and he handled the changes we requested well.

comment: Mata ona widihatama website eka hadala dunna. Changes tikak illuwama ewatath hondatama help kara. Wada eka gana godak sathutui.
translation: He built the website exactly as I wanted and helped with the changes I requested. I'm very happy with the work.

comment: Kalin stock tika manage kale Excel eken. Dan system eken eka karaganna godak lesi. Use karannath amaruwak na.
translation: We used to manage stock in Excel. Now it's much easier with the system, and it's simple to use.

comment: Portfolio eka hithuwata wada lassanata awa. Mobile view ekath niyamai. Communication ekath hondai. Thank you!
translation: The portfolio turned out better than I expected. The mobile view is great, and communication was good too. Thank you!

comment: Very clean design and smooth process from start to finish. Our Colombo clients now check bridal packages and service prices online before messaging us on WhatsApp.
We wanted a clean English website for both local guests and tourists visiting Kandy. The menu, map directions, and opening hours are super easy to find on mobile.
Me encantó cómo quedó la página de mi salón. Quería algo elegante, sin demasiadas cosas, y entendió perfectamente mi idea. También fue muy paciente con los cambios.
translation: I loved how my salon website turned out. I wanted something elegant without too much clutter, and he understood my idea perfectly. He was also very patient with changes.

comment: I wanted my website to feel like an extension of my studio, not a generic salon template. The finished design really captures that.
Love how the menu looks on a phone. We wanted something simple that customers could check before coming in, and that's exactly what we got.
I'm not a tech guy. I just needed a professional website where people could find my services and request a quote. He made the whole thing easy.
The new layout makes our menu much easier to browse. I also appreciated being able to give feedback throughout the design process.
The colors and typography are so much closer to my brand than the website I had before. Really happy with how everything came together!
We needed a straightforward dashboard for managing customer records. The interface is clean and doesn't overwhelm our team with unnecessary features.
Our services and contact information are finally in one place. I liked that he kept the website practical rather than adding a bunch of flashy effects.
The gallery is my favorite part. Our cakes actually get the attention they deserve, and the ordering enquiry is easy to find.
Really pleased with the website. It feels polished without being overdone, and the treatment list is much easier to read now.
I wanted a small site with our opening hours, menu and directions. Nothing complicated. He understood the brief and delivered a lovely design.
A professional-looking site that explains what we do clearly. The quote enquiry form is particularly useful for our business.
We went back and forth on a few details, and he was very accommodating. The finished website has a much warmer feel than our old one.
The photographs have room to breathe rather than being squeezed into tiny boxes. Exactly the sort of layout I was after.
I appreciated the clear explanations about page titles, mobile usability and basic SEO. It helped me understand what was being done and why.
Lovely work. The treatment pages are easy to navigate, and the overall design suits our studio really well.
Pretty stoked with the new site. It's clean, easy to use and feels like our little café rather than a big chain.
Being able to update my own service prices is a massive plus. I don't have to contact a developer every time something changes.
We wanted a better way to showcase completed jobs. The project gallery works really well, especially when showing customers on my phone.
The menu looks great, and the contact details are easy to find. Communication was straightforward, even with the time difference.
The class information is much better organised now. I liked that the design focused on what members actually need to find.
We had a few specific workflow requirements, and he took the time to understand them before building the system. Happy with the result.
We didn't have much content to start with, but he made good use of what we supplied. The site feels welcoming and easy to browse.
I love the calmer design. There's enough information about each treatment without making the pages feel cluttered.
Good experience overall. The website does what we need it to do, and I can easily direct customers to our services page.
He was open to my ideas and didn't try to force a particular style. The finished portfolio feels much more like my own work.
The menu and location details are easy to access, which was important for us. I also like how quickly the pages feel when browsing on mobile.
Very happy with the service layout. Customers can see the treatments and pricing without having to message us for every detail.
The dashboard is practical and easy for our staff to understand. We appreciated the explanations during handover.
Clean design and clear communication. I liked that the website looks professional without relying on unnecessary animations.
We wanted a premium look that matched the interiors of our salon. The colours, spacing and gallery presentation came together beautifully.
The website presents our food and dining space nicely. I appreciated the attention to the mobile layout and the easy-to-find enquiry details.
We needed a simple way to manage our business information without relying on multiple spreadsheets. The custom dashboard fits our workflow well.
